ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How long does SEO actually take to show results?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Local rankings often move within 2 to 3 months, while competitive terms take 4 to 6 months to reach the top of page one and 9 to 12 months to truly dominate. Anyone promising page one in 30 days is either guessing or using tactics that get sites penalised. We set realistic timelines up front and report progress every month.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What's the difference between SEO and Google Ads? Should I do both?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Google Ads buys instant visibility and stops the moment you stop paying. SEO builds organic rankings that compound and keep working over time. Ads are the fastest way to start; SEO lowers your long-term cost per lead. Most growing businesses run Ads first for immediate leads, then layer SEO so they are not renting all of their traffic forever.

No honest SEO can guarantee a specific position, because Google controls the algorithm, not us. Anyone who guarantees #1 is a red flag. What we guarantee is real strategy, transparent reporting and steady, compounding progress on the keywords that bring you customers.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How is your SEO different from cheaper agencies promising the same thing?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Cheap packages usually mean spam backlinks and automated reports with no real action, which can get your site penalised. We do manual, white-hat work: real technical fixes, genuine content, and quality South African backlinks built by outreach. You see exactly what we do each month, and you own every asset.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What happens if I cancel? Do I lose my rankings?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: You keep everything we have built: the on-page work, the content, the technical fixes and the rankings they earned. Because there are no contracts, you can cancel anytime. Rankings may slowly soften without ongoing work as competitors keep pushing, but nothing is taken away when you leave.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do I need a new website for SEO to work?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Not always. If your current site is reasonably fast and well-structured, we can optimise what you have. If it is slow, hard to crawl or built on a limiting platform, a rebuild may be the better investment, and we will tell you honestly which path gives the better return.
